evidence_class: Signed fixture launch grants from LaunchAuthority, fakeredis, the fixture server clock and a fixture network that drops requests, loses responses and repeats a poll response; no live rollout. Live G3 qualification is separate.
interfaces: CommandQueue.issue(execution_id, generation, kind, payload, key, expires_in_ms): the controller issues drain, cancel, answer or stop to the current occupant of a seat; the command id is derived from the swarm, execution and key and never changes, the payload digest covers kind and payload, the same key with the same payload returns the stored command and another payload is revision_conflict; a superseded execution is stale_generation
CommandQueue.outcome(execution_id, command_id): issued, accepted, completed or expired, with accepted_at_ms, completed_at_ms and the reported outcome as separate stored fields
GET /v2/executions/<id>/commands: the credential's own unexpired, uncompleted commands, oldest first, at most poll_limit; a poll sooner than poll_interval_ms is rate_limited with retry same_request
POST /v2/executions/<id>/commands/<command>/ack: receipt with the payload digest; idempotent, an expired command is refused with expired and never accepted

POST /v2/executions/<id>/commands/<command>/complete: the outcome after acceptance, checkpointed with a checkpoint reference or failed for drain, succeeded or failed otherwise; idempotent for the same outcome, another outcome is revision_conflict
scripts.swarm_v2.api.server.Routes(executions, tasks, commands): command paths go to the command endpoints when they are configured

WorkerControl(transport, state_path, handlers): polls, deduplicates by command id, checks the payload digest, stops mutations on a drain before its acknowledgement is confirmed, runs other commands only after the server accepted them, reports drain checkpoint completion separately and keeps unsent acknowledgements and completions in its state file
RouteTransport(execution_id, send): the worker side of the endpoints; same_request refusals become ConnectionError for a later retry, other refusals CommandRefused
worker_command_ack_lag_seconds(store, slug): acceptance minus issue time per accepted command

supported_versions.python: 3.11 and 3.12 unit shards in the linked CI run
supported_versions.protocol: SV2-LDG-02 launch grants and registrations; the credential's execution and generation scope every command endpoint
supported_versions.compatibility: The terminal command path in scripts.swarm_v2.runtime.commands and the local swarm are unchanged; the worker command endpoints are additive and Routes without a command API answers command paths as before

states.observed: A command returned by a worker poll; polling changes no command state
states.accepted: The worker acknowledged the payload digest before expiry; accepted_at_ms is stored
states.committed: The worker reported an outcome after acceptance; completed_at_ms and the outcome are stored
states.externally_verified: None; no production deployment and no live rollout yet

authoritative_objects: The worker-commands hash per execution in Redis is authoritative for command state and is never deleted as a cache
The worker state file is authoritative for what the worker already ran; it is written whole through a staged file and replaced
The worker-command-polls hash only rate limits polls and the worker-command-ack-lag list is a measurement, not state
The ledger document is untouched; it stays authoritative for operator work state

rollback_rehearsal.action: Construct CommandQueue with kinds limited to those still allowed: new commands of a removed kind are refused with forbidden_scope while existing commands are still delivered, acknowledged and completed until they finish or expire
rollback_rehearsal.data_safety: No command record is deleted; reissuing an existing key returns the stored command

remaining_limitations: No production process starts the v2 HTTP server or a worker control loop yet; the kind switch is a constructor argument until a deployment package adds an operator control
Command records for an execution are kept after it ends; retention is not yet bounded
A worker whose state file is lost reports an already accepted command as failed rather than rerunning it; a drain stays in force
A poll from a superseded execution raises CommandRefused to the worker loop's caller; acting on it belongs to the worker entrypoint package

validation.local: No local tests or mutation ran; static prepush passed on every commit

decisions: A worker enters no new mutations mode when it receives a drain, before the server confirmed the acknowledgement: stopping early is safe and a dropped acknowledgement must not let mutations continue; a drain the server refuses lifts it unless another drain holds
Answer, cancel and stop run only after the server accepted them, so an expired command is never run and a retried acknowledgement returns the stored acceptance without a second run
Expiry is derived on read from the stored issue time; an unacknowledged command past its expiry is never delivered or accepted, while an accepted command may still report its outcome after expiry
